# Configuration reference

This table is generated from `config.Catalog()`. It describes supported settings, not the values active on your machine. It never resolves persisted settings, credentials, or environment values.

New installations use `commit.strategy=local` and `commit.format=imperative`. Supported strategies are `local` and `intent`; both publish only through explicit `acd finish`. The second message style is `conventional`. Legacy Event settings translate to local batches during upgrade. Existing verification and privacy choices are preserved below explicit settings and environment overrides; migration does not grant provider consent. Presets, automatic publication timing, candidate waiting and automatic repair settings are unavailable.

Run `acd config get` to inspect effective repository settings and environment overrides. See [Settings](settings.md) for precedence and persistence details.

`capture.max_file_bytes` is a buffering threshold, not an eligibility limit; larger files stream into Git. `ai.timeout` also bounds the combined explicit Intent planning and correction window. See [Settings](settings.md#large-files-and-provider-waits).
